query:
SELECT 
  c.claim_number,
  c.document_processing_status,
  JSON_EXTRACT(a.cost_intelligence_json, '$.compositeOptimisation.compositeL2TotalUsd') as l2_total,
  JSON_EXTRACT(a.cost_intelligence_json, '$.compositeOptimisation.l1TotalUsd') as l1_total,
  JSON_EXTRACT(a.cost_intelligence_json, '$.compositeOptimisation.negotiationFeasibilityScore.score') as nfs_score,
  JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(a.cost_intelligence_json, '$.compositeOptimisation.compositeLineItems')) as composite_items,
  JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(a.cost_intelligence_json, '$.compositeOptimisation.quotedNotDamagedFlags')) as qnd_flags,
  JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(a.cost_intelligence_json, '$.compositeOptimisation.damagedNotQuotedFlags')) as dnq_flags
FROM claims c
JOIN ai_assessments a ON a.claim_id = c.id
WHERE c.claim_number IN ('DOC-20260511-F75D99DD', 'DOC-20260514-14A74979')
ORDER BY c.id;
